items.quote: If you are working with the offline clients and trying to close the deal online, that's exactly the phrases and questions that you have to memorize.
items.statement: Memorize phrases and questions to close deals with offline clients online.

items.quote: What was about the ad that kind of attracted you to respond? What you're actually asking is like, what the hell your problem, Mr. client, is so I can help you to solve it?
items.statement: Start the conversation by asking what attracted the client to the ad, beyond just graphics.

items.quote: If the client is telling you, oh, I don't remember the ad, please don't do this.
items.statement: If the client doesn't remember the ad, don't react negatively but redirect the conversation.

items.quote: And what was your like, um overall goal with this investment, okay?
items.statement: Follow up with asking the client's overall goal with their investment after discussing the ad.
